meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

agents.review_note: Reviewed current Google and OpenAI API docs against tool call IDs, role checks, bounded failover, thought-only responses, per-attempt evidence, and guide retrieval.

auth.review_note: Checked owner-only administration, CSRF guards, scoped MCP digest records and revocation, and private guide access across both agent surfaces.

commerce.review_note: Reconciled issued document sequence exports against stored invoice evidence and checked protected MCP sales aggregates against dashboard definitions.

content.review_note: Reviewed authored page revisions, draft visibility, public search and menu selection, independent blog enhancement previews and manual Apply.

foundation.review_note: Checked existing MySQL storage boundaries for scoped grants and authored pages, CLI migrations, and public/owner data visibility.

google-tags.review_note: Verified the reporting callback and action wrap at phone widths with the hosted URL in Chromium, preserving the URL text and consent path.

http-errors.review_note: Cross-checked provider error and local-budget classification and unavailable private lookups, withheld page responses and edit conflicts.

interface.review_note: Checked owner chat recovery and source links, mobile reporting layout, keyboard menu editing, and separate blog suggestion review controls.

mail.review_note: Verified editorial page and article preview, scheduling and save paths maintain separation from newsletter and order email dispatch.

mcp-clients.review_note: Reviewed trusted local STDIO lifecycle and scope, one-time secret handling, 30-day validity, process-bound discovery and revocation against the pinned client tests.

media.review_note: Reviewed hosted media record ownership, idempotent legacy reconciliation, active content references and native-picker fixture evidence.

operator-help.review_note: Compared owner guide lookup, editorial workflow and review-only enhancement labels with their actual pages, save behavior and source links.

sales-channels.review_note: Checked public product visibility, published navigation destinations and isolated first-party catalogue and policy discovery.

workflow.review_note: Reviewed workflow coverage for loopback provider failures, Chrome, native CLI/MCP tool schemas and server-side scoped credentials.
